32781-blackboard-drawing.title: A Monograph
32781-blackboard-drawing.creator: Frederick Whitney
32781-blackboard-drawing.description: A book by Frederick Whitney. When the drawing on the part of the child becomes the natural and free expression of the activities and interests of every-day life, and the teacher uses this graphic language in the same manner, the blackboards will be found constantly in use and upon them an ever changing series of drawings. These drawings should be illustrations of the geography, history, literature, nature work or any other line demanding their aid.

arxiv-2012-15555.title: Evolution of Subsurface Zonal and Meridional Flows in Solar Cycle 24 from Helioseismological Data Journal: ApJL
arxiv-2012-15555.creator: Alexander V. Getling, Alexander G. Kosovichev, Junwei Zhao
arxiv-2012-15555.description: Abstract The results of determinations of the azimuthal and meridional velocities by time–distance helioseismology from Helioseismic and Magnetic Imager (HMI) onboard Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) from 2010 May to 2020 September at latitudes from − 60 ​ ° -60\degree to + 60 ​ ° +60\degree and depths to about 19 Mm below the photosphere are used to analyze spatiotemporal variations

arxiv-2106-05839.title: Global conformal gauge in string theory
arxiv-2106-05839.creator: M. O. Katanaev
arxiv-2106-05839.description: Abstract It was supposed for fifty years that the conformal gauge in string theory exists globally on the whole string world sheet. In fact, almost all results were obtained under this assumption. However, this statement was proved only locally in some neighbourhood of an arbitrary point on the worldsheet, and its extension is far from being obvious.

arxiv-2109-00574.title: Active label cleaning for improved dataset quality under resource constraints
arxiv-2109-00574.creator: Mélanie Bernhardt, Daniel C. Castro, Ryutaro Tanno, Anton Schwaighofer, Kerem C. Tezcan, Miguel Monteiro, Shruthi Bannur, Matthew P. Lungren, Aditya Nori, Ben Glocker, Javier Alvarez-Valle, Ozan Oktay
arxiv-2109-00574.description: Abstract Imperfections in data annotation, known as label noise, are detrimental to the training of machine learning models and have a confounding effect on the assessment of model performance. Nevertheless, employing experts to remove label noise by fully re-annotating large datasets is infeasible in resource-constrained settings, such as healthcare.

arxiv-2110-07146.title: Prestressed elasticity of amorphous solids
arxiv-2110-07146.creator: Shang Zhang, Ethan Stanifer, Vishwas Vasisht, Leyou Zhang, Emanuela Del Gado, Xiaoming Mao
arxiv-2110-07146.description: Abstract Prestress in amorphous solids bears the memory of their formation, and plays a profound role in their mechanical properties, from stiffening or softening elastic moduli to shifting frequencies of vibrational modes, as well as directing yielding and solidification in the nonlinear regime.

arxiv-2110-13806.title: Detecting speaking persons in video
arxiv-2110-13806.creator: Hannes Fassold
arxiv-2110-13806.description: Abstract We present a novel method for detecting speaking persons in video, by extracting facial landmarks with a neural network and analysing these landmarks statistically over time. I Introduction Knowing which persons are actually speaking in a video at a certain time is an important semantic information which is useful in several application fields.

arxiv-2112-02631.title: Relations between mid-IR dust emission and UV extinction Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2112-02631.creator: Derck Massa, Karl D. Gordon, E. L. Fitzpatrick
arxiv-2112-02631.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Derck Massa, Karl D. Gordon, E. L. Fitzpatrick. We analyze low resolution Spitzer infrared (IR) 5-14 μ \mu m spectra of the diffuse emission toward a carefully selected sample of stars. The sample is composed of sight lines toward stars that have well determined ultraviolet (UV) extinction curves and which are shown to lie beyond effectively all of the extinguishing and emitting dust along their lines of sight.

arxiv-2208-09809.title: Parallel Longest Increasing Subsequence and van Emde Boas Trees Conference: Proceedings of the 35th ACM Symposium on Parallelism in Algorithms and Architectures; June 17–19, 2023; Orlando, FL, USA Proceedings of the 35th ACM Symposium on Parallelism in Algorithms and Architectures (SPAA ’23), June 1
arxiv-2208-09809.creator: Yan Gu, Ziyang Men, Zheqi Shen, Yihan Sun, Zijin Wan
arxiv-2208-09809.description: Abstract . This paper studies parallel algorithms for the longest increasing subsequence (LIS) problem. Let n n be the input size and k k be the LIS length of the input. Sequentially, LIS is a simple problem that can be solved using dynamic programming (DP) in O ⁡ ( n ​ log ⁡ n ) O(n\log n) work.

arxiv-2212-08177.title: The Functional Machine Calculus Journal: Electronic Notes in Theoretical Informatics and Computer Science Volume: 1 Email: wbh22@bath.ac.uk
arxiv-2212-08177.creator: Willem Heijltjes ALL
arxiv-2212-08177.description: Abstract This paper presents the Functional Machine Calculus (FMC) as a simple model of higher-order computation with “reader/writer” effects: higher-order mutable store, input/output, and probabilistic and non-deterministic computation. The FMC derives from the lambda-calculus by taking the standard operational perspective of a call–by–name stack machine as primary, and introducing two natural generalizations.

arxiv-2309-13653.title: Probabilistic Bounds for Data Storage with Feature Selection and Undersampling
arxiv-2309-13653.creator: Ghurumuruhan Ganesan
arxiv-2309-13653.description: Abstract In this paper we consider data storage from a probabilistic point of view and obtain bounds for efficient storage in the presence of feature selection and undersampling, both of which are important from the data science perspective. First, we consider encoding of correlated sources for nonstationary data and obtain a Slepian-Wolf type result for the probability of error.

arxiv-2409-11083.title: Characterisation of TOI-406 as a showcase of the THIRSTEE program
arxiv-2409-11083.creator: G. Lacedelli {}^{\hrefhttps://orcid.org/0000-0002-4197-7374}, E. Pallé {}^{\hrefhttps://orcid.org/0000-0003-0987-1593}, R. Luque {}^{\hrefhttps://orcid.org/0000-0002-4671-2957}, C. Cadieux {}^{\hrefhttps://orcid.org/0000-0001-9291-5555}, J. M. Akana Murphy {}^{\hrefhttps://orcid.org/0000-0001-8898-8
arxiv-2409-11083.description: Abstract Context. The exoplanet sub-Neptune population currently poses a conundrum, as to whether small-size planets are volatile-rich cores without an atmosphere, or rocky cores surrounded by a H-He envelope. To test the different hypotheses from an observational point of view, a large sample of small-size planets with precise mass and radius measurements is the first necessary step.

arxiv-2410-05398.title: Tracing the bottom electroweak dipole operators at future lepton colliders
arxiv-2410-05398.creator: Jiayin Gu, Jiayu Guo, Xiao-Ze Tan
arxiv-2410-05398.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jiayin Gu, Jiayu Guo, Xiao-Ze Tan. While often omitted in the SMEFT analyses of electroweak measurements, the electroweak dipole operators of the bottom quark have been found to be important in some cases and are also related to processes involving the top quark. In this paper, we further investigate their effects, focusing on the measurements of the e + ​ e − → b ​ b ¯ e^{+}e^{-}\to b\bar{b} process at a future lepton collider.

arxiv-2504-07905.title: From Winter Storm Thermodynamics to Wind Gust Extremes: Discovering Interpretable Equations from Data
arxiv-2504-07905.creator: Frederick Iat-Hin Tam, Fabien Augsburger, Tom Beucler
arxiv-2504-07905.description: Abstract Reliably identifying and understanding temporal precursors to extreme wind gusts is crucial for early warning and mitigation. This study proposes a simple data-driven approach to extract key predictors from a dataset of historical extreme European winter windstorms and derive simple equations linking these precursors to extreme gusts over land.

arxiv-2506-11016.title: ZjsComponent: A Pragmatic Approach to Modular, Reusable UI Fragments for Web Development
arxiv-2506-11016.creator: Lelanthran Manickum
arxiv-2506-11016.description: Abstract In this paper, I present ZjsComponent , a lightweight and framework-agnostic web component designed for creating modular, reusable UI elements with minimal developer overhead. ZjsComponent is an example implementation of an approach to creating components and object instances that can be used purely from HTML.

pmc-11548297.title: Synergistic Reinforcing Effect of Hazelnut Shells and Hydrotalcite on Properties of Rigid Polyurethane Foam Composites
pmc-11548297.creator: Sylwia Makowska, Karolina Miedzińska, Agnė Kairytė, Krzysztof Strzelec, Valentina Siracusa, Dimitrios Bikiaris
pmc-11548297.description: Recently, the development of composite materials from agricultural and forestry waste has become an attractive area of research. The use of bio-waste is beneficial for economic and environmental reasons, adapting it to cost effectiveness and environmental sustainability. In the presented study, the possibility of using hazelnut shell (HS) and hydrotalcite (HT) mineral filler was investigated.

pmc-12508782.title: A Case of Cardiobacterium hominis Endocarditis Manifesting as Isolated Renal Infarction: Clinical Insights and Novel Presentation
pmc-12508782.creator: Jotaro Yamamoto, Chinatsu Komiyama, Mizuki Haraguchi, Masamichi Imai, Takahide Kodama
pmc-12508782.description: A 47-year-old woman presented with renal infarction due to an unknown etiology. Intravascular ultrasonography (IVUS) revealed emboli rather than dissection, guiding successful renal artery intervention that resolved her abdominal pain and preserved renal function. Blood culture revealed Cardiobacterium hominis, and echocardiography confirmed infective endocarditis with vegetation on the mitral valve.

pmc-12659477.title: Modeling CIC::DUX4 sarcoma reveals oncogene-mediated MHCI-dependent immune evasion
pmc-12659477.creator: Ajay Ram Vachanaram, Erdong Wei, Ana Mitanoska, William Bassett, Michael Kyba, Darko Bosnakovski
pmc-12659477.description: CIC::DUX4 sarcoma (CDS) is a highly aggressive malignancy with limited therapeutic options. Here, we present a doxycycline-inducible CIC::DUX4 chimeric mouse model and a cancer line derived from it, imChCDS, that faithfully recapitulates the molecular, histological, and immunological features of human CDS. We demonstrate that CIC::DUX4 expression alone is sufficient to drive tumorigenesis in permissive lineages of soft connective tissues.

pmc-12711629.title: How accurately does L band vegetation optical depth predict aboveground biomass?
pmc-12711629.creator: Yuan Zhang, Philippe Ciais, Jean-Pierre Wigneron, Jérôme Chave, Nan Cong, Xiaojun Li, Yan Yang, Sassan Saatchi
pmc-12711629.description: Highlights•The performances of different methods to predict AGB using L-VOD are investigated.•Adding tree cover remarkably improves L-VOD-based AGB prediction.•All methods fail to capture AGB spatial variation in dense rainforests, where reference data also show large discrepancies.•The temporal relationships between AGB and L-VOD differ from the spatial relationships.

pmc-12749800.title: Associations of sleep duration and sleep quality with lifestyle inflammation score in a nationwide Korean survey
pmc-12749800.creator: Jaegeun Cho, Eunvin Kang, Se Eun Kim, Young-Joo Won
pmc-12749800.description: This cross-sectional study evaluated the association between sleep health and the Lifestyle Inflammation Score (LIS), which has not been sufficiently examined in previous research. We further assessed whether inadequate sleep duration and poor sleep quality are associated with a higher LIS. Moreover, we explored the effects of age, sex, and income.

pmc-13185054.title: The complete chloroplast genome sequence of Malva pusilla Sm. (Malvaceae), a medicinal plant
pmc-13185054.creator: Junjie Wei, Wenjing Li, Xingchen Liu, Yingying Yan, Xiaoming Guo, Peiyan Ai, Menghao Wang, Xiaolong Xie, Xiaozheng Luo, Jianfeng Chang, Yanan Cao, Lianzhen Li
pmc-13185054.description: Malva pusilla Sm. is a perennial herb used for both medicinal and edible purposes. Here, we sequenced and assembled the complete chloroplast genome (plastome) of M. pusilla. The plastome is 158,345 base pairs (bp) in length, with a GC content of 37.12%, and exhibits a typical quadripartite structure.

pmc-13293229.title: Segmenting Older Adults by Their Acceptance of Digital Health Care Devices: Cross-Sectional Study Using the Augmented Technology Acceptance Model and K-Means Clustering
pmc-13293229.creator: Taeyeon Koo, Ill Hyung Jo, Do Young Pyun, Jinho Yoo

pmc-13326802.title: Food‐Related Attentional Biases in Restrained Eaters: A Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13326802.creator: Rio Madan, Cristina Martinelli
pmc-13326802.description: ObjectiveDietary restraint may contribute to the development and maintenance of eating disorders (EDs), with food‐related attentional biases (ABs) as a key underlying mechanism. We examined associations between dietary restraint and ABs and explored how several methodological factors (i.e., AB mechanism, mode of AB investigation, response task type, stimulus task relevance, and type of food stimulus) might influence these associations.

pmc-13522372.title: Characteristics of Primary and acquired multidrug-resistant tuberculosis patients in West Java, Indonesia
pmc-13522372.creator: Prayudi Santoso, Alya Putri Khairani, Eppy Buchori, Lidya Chaidir, Arto Yuwono Soeroto
pmc-13522372.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Highlights•Primary multidrug-resistant tuberculosis made up 32% of 337 cases.•Tuberculosis contact raised primary multidrug-resistant tuberculosis odds four-fold.•Age, body mass index, and clinical features did not differ significantly.•Linezolid resistance was found in primary cases.•Acquired multidrug-resistant tuberculosis showed more diverse drug resistance. Introduction

Resistance to anti-tuberculosis drugs is a significant constraint that is often encountered in tuberculosis (TB) control and creates an additional burden on TB control programs [1].

pmc-13605385.title: Perpetual Futures for Stocks: The SpaceX Pre-IPO Market
pmc-13605385.creator: Aditya Gupta, Nicholas G. Polson
pmc-13605385.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Robert Shiller proposed perpetual futures in 1993 to create derivative markets for assets that are illiquid or whose price cannot be observed directly. Cryptocurrency markets later built the instrument under a different funding rule. We give a single no-arbitrage result that nests both designs: the perpetual price is the present value of a benchmark flow discounted at the funding rate, so the funding rule fixes both the benchmark and the discount.
